fields.FIR_Description: As per the FIR recorded on 2026-06-30, a person offering to buy an item listed online asked the complainant to approve a UPI request, following which Rs. 96,000 was withdrawn. The time of the incident was given as 13:05 on 2026-06-25. Praveen Muthu submitted the complaint online using the mobile number 9000000222. Senthil Natarajan (mobile 9000000262) was named as a possible person of interest. Padmini Raj (9000000032) was mentioned as a person who was present nearby. Funds were reportedly sent to the account reference SYN-ACC-100005.
fields.Evidence_Mentioned: Call detail reference; Social media screenshot
fields.Modus_Operandi: Suspect allegedly posed as an online buyer and requested payment approval.
fields.Keywords: UPI fraud, online payment, screenshot, suspect, witness, afternoon, mobile number, main street
